mapper.select: WITH acts AS ( SELECT target_id AS playlist_id, played_at AS at, 0 AS minutes FROM play_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_type = 'PLAYLIST' AND played_at >= #{fromUtc} AND played_at < #{toUtc} UNION ALL SELECT playlist_id, listened_at, minutes FROM listen_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND listened_at >= #{fromUtc} AND listened_at < #{toUtc} ) SELECT ((a.at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') - INTERVAL '17 hours')::date AS night, a.playlist_id, p.title, p.title_en, MIN(a.at) AS first_at, MAX(a.minutes) AS minutes FROM acts a JOIN playlist p ON p.id = a.playlist_id GROUP BY 1, a.playlist_id, p.title, p.title_en ORDER BY 1, MIN(a.at)
SELECT night, rating FROM sleep_night WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND night BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sleep_night (user_id, night, rating) VALUES (#{userId}, #{night}, #{rating}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, night) DO UPDATE SET rating = EXCLUDED.rating, rated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sleep_night_playlist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND night = #{night}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sleep_night_playlist (user_id, night, playlist_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{night}, #{id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT g.code, g.name, g.name_en, COUNT(*) AS weight FROM sleep_night sn JOIN sleep_night_playlist sp ON sp.user_id = sn.user_id AND sp.night = sn.night JOIN playlist_layer l ON l.playlist_id = sp.playlist_id JOIN playlist_block pb ON pb.layer_id = l.id JOIN block b ON b.id = pb.block_id JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id JOIN sound_category g ON g.id = COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) WHERE sn.user_id = #{userId} AND sn.rating = 3 AND sn.night >= #{since} AND g.is_active = true GROUP BY g.id, g.code, g.name, g.name_en, g.sort_order ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, g.sort_order LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sp.playlist_id, COUNT(*) AS good_nights, MAX(sn.night) AS last_night FROM sleep_night sn JOIN sleep_night_playlist sp ON sp.user_id = sn.user_id AND sp.night = sn.night WHERE sn.user_id = #{userId} AND sn.rating = 3 AND sn.night BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY sp.playlist_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(sn.night) DESC, sp.playlist_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating > 0) AS rated, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 3) AS good, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 2) AS okay, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 1) AS bad FROM sleep_night WHERE night >= #{since}
